page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a bracket diagram (conjugation paradigm) in the middle; a bracket beside the lower paradigm; no marginal notes; page number top right.

main_text.p: Coloro leggerebbono, & leggeriano, daß sie lesen, oder leseten.
main_text.head: Prateritum perfectum.
main_text.p: Daß ich hab, du habst, er hab, Daß wir haben, daß jhr habt, daß sie haben gelesen.
main_text.head: Prateritum Plusq. perfect.
main_text.p: O Dio volesse, che io, tu hauessi, colui hauesse, letto. Vtinam ego legissem, tu legisses, ille legisset, daß ich, du, er solt haben gelesen.

p.i: Noi hauessimo, voi hauesti, & coloro hauessero letto.
Nos legissemus, vos legissetis, illi legissent.

main_text.p: Wir solten haben, jhr soltet haben, sie solten haben gelesen.
O che io hauerei & haueria letto, Daß ich hätte gelesen.

page.notes: Bracket-enclosed paradigm columns on left and right; the braces are rendered as diagram lines. Catchword "Daß" at lower right of page and signature "K" at foot are shown as foot lines. Some words in the scan are uncertain (e.g. "hauessi", "legisses") due to faded print.
